dc:title: cabinets_fo
dc:description: cabinets_fo is provided as csv and rds file in /data/processed/. It contains information on coalition governments of the Faroe Islands, in particular a timeline including the parties that are part of each cabinet during the timeframe covered by the northatlantic_ft dataset. Refer to the documentation for more details.
